brief: The 5 scalp habits dermatologists wish you'd adopt this year.

slots.author: Elena Voss
slots.subtitle: THE SECRETS DERMATOLOGISTS WANT YOU TO KNOW NOW

slots.author: Elena Voss
slots.title: THE ROOT CAUSE
slots.body: Beautiful hair begins at the root. This year, dermatologists are treating the scalp as skincare, not an afterthought. Here are five gentle shifts to adopt today.

slots.author: Elena Voss
slots.title: EXFOLIATE WEEKLY
slots.body: Product buildup and dead skin block follicles. A weekly enzymatic or acid-based scrub keeps the scalp balanced and breathing.

slots.author: Elena Voss
slots.title: DAILY MASSAGE
slots.body: Two minutes of gentle circular motion increases circulation and nutrient delivery. It also eases tension you did not know you were holding.

slots.author: Elena Voss
slots.title: TREAT LIKE SKIN
slots.body: Your scalp deserves serums with niacinamide and peptides. Targeted formulas strengthen the barrier without weighing strands down.

slots.author: Elena Voss
slots.title: GENTLE CLEANSING
slots.body: Overwashing strips natural oils and triggers rebound oiliness. Choose sulfate-free formulas and lukewarm water for a calmer scalp.

slots.author: Elena Voss
slots.title: SHIELD FROM SUN
slots.body: UV exposure ages the scalp and weakens the hairline. Apply SPF mist along the part or wear a hat when the sun is strong.
